display.purpose: Page H1s, family and type names on their heroes, the 404 statement, the closing die-band statement.

headline.purpose: Every section heading, and the statement on a picture-less "Get to know" card.

title.purpose: Headings inside a section; type tile, "Get to know" card and about-band headings.

card-title.purpose: Product names, process steps, FAQ questions.

lede.purpose: The one line under a heading, in Graphite.

label-small.purpose: Nav links, family strip labels and footer.

shadows.name: deboss
shadows.purpose: Every pill on :active, paired with translateY(1px).

shadows.name: object-grounding
shadows.purpose: filter on transparent cut-out renders wherever they sit (tiles, heroes, cards, product fallbacks); never on containers.

shadows.name: field-focus
shadows.purpose: Input and textarea focus, with ink border.

motion.name: ease-strike
motion.purpose: The strike and the 700ms image hover scale.

motion.name: strike
motion.value: @keyframes strike { from { transform: scale(1.045); filter: blur(6px) } to { transform: scale(1); filter: blur(0) } }
motion.purpose: The one authored motion; never starts from opacity 0.

motion.name: strike-on-load
motion.purpose: Opening render of a page only (home hero, family hero render, type hero image); animation: none under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: strike-on-view
motion.value: strike linear both; animation-timeline: view(); animation-range: entry 10% cover 45%
motion.purpose: Home embossed plate only; gated on @supports (animation-timeline: view()); none under reduced motion.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Pill colour, shadow and transform feedback; chevron nudge.

motion.name: image-hover
motion.purpose: Product, family and type tile images on hover; the family strip thumbnail scales 1.06 over 500ms.

imagery.studioRenders: public/assets/home/*.webp, each with a .webp.json sidecar {prompt, createdAt} recording origin and every grade or crop.
imagery.cutOuts: public/assets/bento/*.webp transparent (strip thumbnails 320px in public/assets/bento/thumb), served unoptimized, object-contain bottom, object-grounding shadow. Last fallback for every catalog image spot, including placeholder product photos.
imagery.catalogPhotos: Sanity images cropped square 800x800 fit=crop in an aluminium well; type tiles 4:3; type heroes and Get to know cards square cover; detail gallery 4:3; journal 16:10 or 16:9.
imagery.clientMarks: Greyscale, 75% opacity, multiply blend, per-mark optical height, no boxes.
imagery.leadSpots: Type tiles, type heroes and Get to know cards use studio renders, cut-outs, Sanity images set on that type or card, or catalog photos on the LEAD_PHOTOS allowlist (data/families.ts) that are at least 1000px wide (canLead in lib/catalog.ts). Client-marked catalog photos stay in the style grids.

narrative.overview:
Metro Metal's catalog is presented the way a maker presents its finest objects: one piece of hardware per viewport, at studio scale, with one sentence about it. The ground is gallery white and aluminium grey, alternating in full-width bands, broken once per page by a near-black die band where the object is lit from above. Everything else steps back so the metal reads.

The world's ritual is the die coming down on the mark. It shows up in two places and nowhere else: the strike motion (an image settling from slightly large and soft to exact and sharp) and the pressed state of every pill (a 1px deboss). Focus is the die edge, a 2px ink ring offset 3px. The current item in a wayfinding row (the global nav, the family strip) reads in full ink at medium weight against graphite neighbours; nothing is filled to show selection. There is no decorative motion, no eyebrow label and no icon tile; size alone ranks content.

Density is low and confident. Sections breathe at 96px on phones and 128px on desktop, headings are large and tight, copy is short, and the one accent, plum, is spent on the quote action and on text links.
keyCharacteristics: White and aluminium bands, one die-black band per page.
Geist throughout, semibold and tightly tracked at display sizes, 17px body.
Pills for actions, "Label ›" plum links for navigation.
Borderless rounded tiles on aluminium, with no strokes and no card shadows.
States are impressions: deboss on press, die-edge ring on focus. The current page reads in full ink at medium weight.
One authored motion, the strike, always visible from the first frame and removed under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Plum fills only the quote action and colours only text links. No plum backgrounds, borders, icons or headings. On the die band the quote pill turns light, so plum never sits on black.

rules.name: The One Die Rule
rules.body: A page gets at most one die-black band, and it carries a lit object. Every element inside it sits under `.on-die`, so the focus ring flips to Die Light.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No small label sits above a heading. No kicker, no overline, no uppercase tracked tag, and no "01". The heading carries the weight, and context goes in the lede below it.

rules.name: The Scale-Utility Rule
rules.body: Headings use the display, headline, title and lede scale utilities. A new one-off clamp is a defect, not a new step.

rules.name: The Impression Rule
rules.body: Shadows go inward. The only outward shadow grounds a cut-out object, and it is never put on a container.

rules.name: The Die Edge Rule
rules.body: Every focusable element shows a 2px ink outline offset 3px on `:focus-visible`. Inside `.on-die` the outline is Die Light. Fields add their own soft ring on top.

rules.name: The Cleared Lead Rule
rules.body: Lead spots (type tiles, type heroes and "Get to know" cards) show only studio renders, cut-outs, images set on that type or card in Sanity, or catalog photos on the `LEAD_PHOTOS` allowlist that are at least 1000px wide. Catalog photos that carry a client's mark never lead. They stay in the style grids.

dos: Do let one object own each viewport, at studio scale, on white, aluminium or die.
Do spend plum only on the quote pill and text links. On the die band, use the light pill.
Do open sections with the Section Intro and inner pages with the Page Header, using the scale utilities.
Do express state as impressions: 1px deboss on press and a 2px ink ring offset 3px on focus. Mark the current page with full ink at medium weight.
Do carry the product name into every quote action that has one.
Do ship a `.webp.json` provenance sidecar beside every new raster.
Do crop catalog photos square in an aluminium well with the tile radius.
Do lead with studio renders or cleared catalog photos only. Client-marked photos stay in the style grids.
Do close every style grid on the "Not in the catalog?" tile.
donts: Don't put an eyebrow, kicker, overline or numbered tag above a heading.
Don't add borders or drop shadows to tiles. The only outward shadow grounds a cut-out object.
Don't add a second authored motion, timed carousels or fade-in reveals. The strike never starts from opacity 0.
Don't use off-palette greys or reds (Tailwind slate, gray or red scales). Use the named tokens.
Don't use icon tiles or glyph icons as decoration. Icons appear only as functional chevrons, controls and brand marks (WhatsApp, mail).
Don't use more than one die band on a page.
